rationale: David brings a decade of production robotics experience (drones at Skycatch, autonomous tractors at Agtonomy) and is now building real-time infrastructure at LiveKit specifically for robotics systems—a domain Tom is also operating in with Ruyi Dynamics. Tom is early-stage and could benefit from David's rare end-to-end perspective on shipping autonomous systems and the production infrastructure challenges he's now solving.
intro_message: David Chen, meet Tom Zhanh — you're both in robotics and David's spent a decade shipping autonomous systems to production while now building the real-time infrastructure layer robotics teams actually need.
